mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student(name, no, gender, phone, id_card, is_college, address, degree, graduation_date, clazz_id, create_time, update_time) # VALUES ('丽莎','2025010509',2,'15887989865',159080878965450909,1,'辽宁沈阳',4,'2025-09-08',9,'2025-09-09','2025-09-09'); VALUES (#{name}, #{no}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{idCard}, #{isCollege}, #{address}, #{degree}, #{graduationDate}, #{clazzId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, c.name FROM student s LEFT JOIN clazz c ON s.clazz_id = c.id WHERE s.id = #{id}

UPDATE student
name = #{name},
no = #{no},
gender = #{gender},
degree = #{degree},
phone = #{phone},
id_card = #{idCard},
is_college = #{isCollege},
address = #{address},
graduation_date = #{graduationDate},
violation_count = #{violationCount},
violation_score = #{violationScore},
clazz_id = #{clazzId},
update_time = #{updateTime},
WHERE id = #{id};
mapper.select: select (case when degree = 1 then '初中' when degree = 2 then '高中' when degree = 3 then '大专' when degree = 4 then '本科' when degree = 5 then '硕士' when degree = 6 then '博士' end) name, count(*) value from student group by degree
SELECT c.name clazzName, COUNT(s.id) stuNum FROM clazz c LEFT JOIN student s ON c.id = s.clazz_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY stuNum;
